description: Properties potentially usable under the owners' operating model - chalet, lodge, pension, guesthouse, small hotel, large short-stay house, or fixer-upper with hospitality potential. Excludes the Yuzawa resort-apartment set, which is market evidence rather than candidate stock.
currency_note: JPY is the source value. AUD shown at 112.37 JPY/AUD as at 2026-08-16 (data/reference/cost-assumptions.json). AUD figures are CALCULATION, not source data.
availability_warning: Several sources are dated editorial listing round-ups. A property appearing in a Dec-2023 or Dec-2024 article may long since have sold or been withdrawn. Every record carries source_date and an availability flag. AVAILABILITY UNVERIFIED means the listing was published at that date and has NOT been re-confirmed as of 2026-08-20.
